items.title: Optimize Email Health Checks for Faster Campaigns in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces caching for the console's health checks while ensuring that the email sending path always performs a fresh probe. This change addresses user feedback regarding delays in sending campaigns by reducing unnecessary wait times during health checks. Additionally, tests have been added to ensure the integrity of health checks and prevent false positives in failure scenarios.

items.title: Clean Up Disk Space for Smooth Deployments in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses deployment failures caused by insufficient disk space on the runner. By removing unnecessary pre-installed toolchains and cleaning up dangling images, we ensure that the build process can complete successfully. This change is crucial for unlocking the deployment of the latest code changes.

items.title: Fix attachment handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where attachments were silently dropped when a message was sent alongside references. The `buildUserContent` function has been modified to ensure that references are processed correctly, allowing attachments to be recognized and utilized. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the fix's effectiveness.

items.title: Fix email delivery count and enhance recipient selection width in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the email delivery count was incorrectly displayed as zero due to case sensitivity in the keys from the backend. Additionally, the width of the recipient selection section has been increased to utilize more screen space, improving the overall user experience while maintaining readability for email composition. These changes are aimed at providing accurate statistics and a more efficient interface.

items.title: Fix email campaign recipient stats for real-time accuracy in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the email campaign list displayed outdated recipient statistics due to reliance on a stored snapshot. The list interface now performs a live count of recipients, ensuring that the displayed data reflects the current state of campaigns. A new test has been added to validate this functionality, confirming that the interface returns accurate counts.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Worker to Accept Numeric Strings for Timestamps in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update allows the OpenAI worker to accept Unix timestamps serialized as strings, ensuring compatibility with ISO timestamps. A regression test has been added to validate the changes and prevent future issues. The modifications enhance the handling of timestamp data, improving overall stability.

items.title: Enhance Gemini and Grok CLIs with Advanced Chat Options in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new advanced chat parameters to the `gemini` and `grok` CLIs, enhancing their functionality. Key additions include 15 new options for `gemini/chat.py` and 11 for `grok/chat.py`, allowing for more flexible and powerful chat interactions. A new `_json.py` helper module has also been added to streamline JSON handling in CLI options.

items.title: Enhance grok service_tier and fix sora version format in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `service_tier` parameter to the `/grok/chat/completions` endpoint, allowing for more flexible service options. Additionally, it corrects the `version` field in the `/sora/videos` spec to ensure it sends a string instead of an integer. These changes improve compliance with the latest OpenAPI specifications and enhance functionality.

items.title: Add DigitalHuman, DrawAI, and QRArt CLIs; fix async flag in Flux in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new CLI packages—DigitalHuman, DrawAI, and QRArt—implementing APIs for video generation, headshot creation, and QR art generation respectively. Each package includes commands for generating content and managing tasks, following existing monorepo conventions. Additionally, the Flux CLI now supports the --async flag for generate and edit commands, aligning with the updated API specification. These enhancements expand CLI capabilities and improve asynchronous operation support.

items.title: Align /auth Timestamp with Workers in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the `started_at` timestamp in the /auth endpoint to float epoch seconds, aligning it with the worker side changes. It ensures that the localization worker receives a correctly formatted timestamp, preventing silent data loss and billing discrepancies. The change maintains compatibility with existing parsing methods and requires no modifications to the Lua plugin.

items.title: Enhance Task Documentation with Timing Fields in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds missing timing fields (`started_at`, `finished_at`, and `elapsed`) to 28 task documentation files, ensuring consistency with the existing field descriptions. The changes rectify previous omissions that could lead to confusion for users implementing the API. All updates have been validated for accuracy and consistency.

items.title: Enhance Device Diagnostics for Model Clarity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of device error reporting by allowing the model to receive detailed failure causes instead of generic 'unknown_outcome' messages. Key changes include modifications to the `foldRelayResult` function to extract and relay the actual error details from the device. Additionally, outdated assertions have been updated to reflect current timeout constraints, ensuring better reliability in error handling.

items.title: Enhance Error Reporting for Cloud Diagnostics in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new `CommandFailure` class to improve error reporting by providing detailed diagnostic information when failures occur. Key changes include the ability to distinguish between multiple error states and enhancements to the relay mechanism to ensure accurate error transmission to the cloud. This will significantly aid in identifying the root causes of failures during operations.

items.title: Disable Send Button When Email Switch is Off in Frontend Web 🚫
items.summary: This update ensures that the send button is disabled when the global email sending switch is turned off, preventing users from encountering error messages. Tooltips have been added to guide users on how to enable the sending feature. The changes enhance user experience by providing clearer feedback on the email sending status.

items.title: Exciting New Lip-Sync and Talking-Photo Tools in M C Ps 🎤
items.summary: This update introduces two powerful tools: `kling_lip_sync`, which synchronizes lip movements with audio or text-to-speech, and `kling_talking_photo`, which animates a portrait to speak using an audio clip. Key changes include new enums for lip-sync modes and audio types, as well as the addition of async methods for both tools. The tools are now registered and ready for use, enhancing the capabilities of the Kling MCP server.

items.title: Update Plugin Download Link and Add Edge Instructions in Backend 🚀
items.summary: The download link for the Ace Data Cloud browser plugin has been updated to a stable, automatically published URL, eliminating the need for future manual updates. Additionally, installation instructions for Edge have been added to ensure users have the correct guidance for both Chrome and Edge browsers. This change enhances the documentation's accuracy and usability.

items.title: Add Browser Extension Download Button in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new button on the download page for users to easily download the browser extension for Chrome and Edge. The button links to a CDN-hosted zip file, ensuring users have direct access without needing to navigate through documentation. Additionally, minor style adjustments were made to improve mobile responsiveness.

items.title: Fix pricing display for clamped rules in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where clamped pricing rules were incorrectly rendering raw JsonLogic in the price table. The fix ensures that only the relevant pricing information is displayed, improving readability and user experience. Additionally, new tests have been added to verify the correct display of these rules.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Transcriptions Documentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds the missing documentation nodes for the OpenAI audio transcriptions API, ensuring visibility on the platform. It includes the creation of both API and integration documents, which were previously orphaned. The changes improve user access to the API and enhance the overall documentation experience.

items.title: Enhance Mobile Experience with Collapsible Bottom App Bar in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a collapsible bottom app bar for mobile devices, reducing its height from 60px to a slim 22px handle. Users can now reclaim valuable screen space while maintaining access to navigation features, with the state persisted across sessions. Additionally, the PR includes fixes for three identified issues and translations for 18 languages.

items.title: Standardizing Task Timing Fields to Unix Timestamps in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update focuses on unifying the format of three task timing fields—`created_at`, `started_at`, and `finished_at`—to Unix floating-point seconds. The decision to retain `created_at` eliminates several risks related to pagination and task execution order, ensuring smoother operations across services. Additionally, extensive audits and adjustments have been made to address existing issues and improve overall system reliability.

items.title: Standardize Unix Timestamps Across API Docs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the API documentation with the worker-side format by converting 87 schema declarations to use Unix floating-point seconds. Additionally, it fixes a bug from a previous PR that incorrectly declared timestamps as strings in 25 specs. Two previously undocumented endpoints have also been updated to include timing fields, ensuring consistency and clarity for users.

items.title: Standardize Timing Fields to Unix Float Seconds in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update unifies the `started_at` and `finished_at` fields to use float epoch seconds across the Platform Service, resolving inconsistencies in data formats. Additionally, it addresses three silent bugs related to timing checks and introduces a new CI job for TypeScript testing, ensuring better coverage and reliability. A critical billing bug was also fixed to prevent erroneous charges due to incorrect timestamp calculations.

items.title: Enhance Email Card Layout for Better Readability in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the email marketing card layout by changing it from a single-line flex to a two-line grid. This adjustment allows for complete visibility of Chinese titles without line breaks or truncation, improving user experience. The card dimensions have been optimized, resulting in a more visually appealing design.

items.title: Automate CDN Uploads for Extensions in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new workflow to automatically build and upload browser extension packages to the CDN upon merging changes to the main branch. It resolves the previous manual upload process and ensures that the latest version is always available at a stable URL, improving user access and documentation accuracy. Additionally, it includes version synchronization checks between manifest and package files to prevent discrepancies.

items.title: New `transcribe` Command for Audio Transcriptions in Clis 🎤
items.summary: This update introduces a new `transcribe` command that allows users to transcribe audio files using the OpenAI API. Key changes include the addition of a multipart request method and a new command that supports various options like language, model, and response format. This enhancement significantly improves the CLI's functionality for audio processing tasks.

items.title: Add audio transcription tool with OpenAI integration in M C Ps 🎤
items.summary: This update introduces the `openai_transcribe_audio` tool, enabling audio transcription via the new OpenAI endpoint. Key changes include new types for audio transcription models and response formats, along with a method for handling multipart file uploads. Comprehensive tests have been added to ensure functionality and error handling for the new feature.

items.title: Added glm-5.2 to VISIBLE_MODELS in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update includes the addition of `glm-5.2` to the `VISIBLE_MODELS` list, ensuring that it is now recognized in the model directory. While this change does not affect existing clients using `glm-5.2`, it improves visibility for new clients checking model availability. Other identified issues related to upstream behavior will be addressed separately.

items.title: Enhance API Mapping for OpenAI Transcriptions in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds the OpenAI Audio Transcriptions API to the service API mapping, enhancing the documentation for developers. The change includes 15 new lines of code while ensuring that unrelated API entries are excluded, streamlining the mapping process. This focused addition improves the clarity and usability of the API documentation.

items.title: Enhance Seedance Failover Routing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a task-aware routing mechanism for Seedance submissions, allowing failed requests to be redirected to the Bananarouter instead of failing outright. Key changes include the addition of a new configuration and deployment for the failover router, ensuring that tasks can be re-dispatched without client-visible changes. The implementation aims to improve reliability and reduce timeout issues experienced by users.

items.title: Enhance BananaRouter to Accept Dated Seedance Model ID in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update allows BananaRouter to accept the dated seedance model ID, resolving a model-id mismatch that previously caused all requests to fail validation. By mapping the dated ID to the listed ID only at the upstream boundary, the task record and client response will retain the original ID sent by callers. This change is expected to enable BananaRouter to handle approximately 50% of seedance traffic on the base 2.0 model, improving overall service reliability.

items.title: Fix local task execution and enhance tray icon visibility in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical bug where local tasks were incorrectly routed through the cloud instead of the daemon, preventing access to local tools. Additionally, the tray icon has been redesigned for better visibility, ensuring it meets macOS menu bar standards. The changes improve user experience by providing clearer feedback and functionality for local task execution.

items.title: Transform Mobile Controls to Dialog in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update enhances the mobile user experience by replacing inline secondary composer controls with a dedicated settings dialog. The dialog features labeled rows for each control, improving clarity and usability. Desktop functionality remains unchanged, ensuring a seamless transition between devices.

items.title: Revamp Connector Authorization for Desktop, iOS, and Android in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a unified authorization flow for connectors across desktop, iOS, and Android platforms, resolving issues where previous attempts resulted in silent failures or stuck screens. The new method ensures that the consent page opens in the appropriate browser for each platform, and the application refreshes correctly upon returning. Additionally, it includes improvements to error handling and internationalization support.

items.title: Fix email preview layout for audience selection in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves the issue where the email preview was overlapping with the audience selection, causing the recipient table to be pushed out of view. By adjusting the layout to hide the preview during audience selection, the recipient table is now displayed correctly alongside the grouping options. The changes have been tested and verified for functionality and layout integrity.

items.title: Enhance Liveness Probe for Agent Health Checks in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the liveness probe to utilize a deep health check endpoint, ensuring that the agent's actual status is monitored rather than just the gateway's port availability. The change aims to prevent prolonged undetected outages by allowing Kubernetes to accurately assess the agent's health. Additionally, the readiness probe remains unchanged to avoid unnecessary failures during brief service interruptions.

items.title: Enhance task output with timestamps in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update adds `started_at` and `elapsed` fields to the task response output in the CLI, improving the visibility of task timing. The `print_task_result` function has been modified to display these new fields, while maintaining backward compatibility with the legacy `duration` key. Additionally, tests have been updated to ensure the new labels appear correctly in the output.

items.title: Exciting New Text-to-Speech Tool Added in M C Ps 🎤
items.summary: We've introduced a new text-to-speech tool for the `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint, enhancing our audio capabilities. Key changes include the addition of new types for audio models and voices, a wrapper function for audio requests, and comprehensive documentation for usage. This tool allows users to convert text into spoken audio, returning base64-encoded audio data.

items.title: Fix golden build failures in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses issues causing the golden build to fail during the final step. Key changes include improved health checks and adjustments to the API account assertions, ensuring that the system correctly handles responses from the agent and gateway. These modifications enhance the reliability of the build process, particularly for clean images.

items.title: Add OpenAI Speech Recognition API in Backend 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces the `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint for speech-to-text functionality, enabling the platform to process audio files using the whisper-1 model. Key changes include the addition of billing rules based on audio duration and comprehensive documentation updates. The implementation ensures compatibility with existing OpenAI SDKs, allowing seamless integration for users.

items.title: Introducing OpenAI-Compatible Speech Recognition in Platform Service 🤖
items.summary: This update adds a new OpenAI-compatible endpoint for speech-to-text transcriptions, allowing for seamless audio processing. The implementation utilizes the whisper-1 model, ensuring accurate transcriptions in English and Chinese, with proper billing mechanisms in place. Additionally, the upload limit has been increased to 25MB to align with OpenAI's standards.

items.title: Update Connector Links for Accurate User Guidance in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes two outdated links in the installation guide for the AceDataCloud connector, directing users to the new connector page at studio.acedata.cloud. Previously, users were led to an old page, causing confusion and hindering the verification of plugin installation. The changes ensure users can easily access the correct platform for authorization.

items.title: Fix cookie fetching issue after connector migration in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where cookie-based authentication for connectors failed after migrating to the new studio URL. The plugin's domain whitelist has been updated to include `studio.acedata.cloud`, ensuring proper injection of content scripts and successful cookie retrieval. All tests have passed, confirming the stability of the changes.

items.title: Connector Authorization Issues Across Native Platforms in Index 🚧
items.summary: This PR documents the current state of connector authorization issues across Electron, Android, and iOS platforms, highlighting critical failures in functionality. Key findings reveal that all three platforms exhibit unique symptoms, such as silent failures and UI freezes, due to inadequate handling of `window.open()`. A comprehensive fix plan is outlined, leveraging existing infrastructure to address these issues without requiring changes to the AuthBackend.

items.title: Fix grid item overlap issue with min-width adjustments in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the persistent grid item overlap issue by explicitly setting min-width to 0 for specific elements. Additionally, it ensures that the el-table respects the maximum width constraints, preventing overflow. The changes have been validated online, showing significant improvements in layout stability across various screen sizes.

items.title: Align Upload Timeout with Relay Limits in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the upload timeout in the transfer manifest from 600 seconds to 120 seconds, aligning it with the relay's maximum timeout. A new test has been added to ensure that the upload command remains the longest timeout, preventing future regressions. This change addresses a critical issue where uploads were consistently failing due to timeout mismatches.

items.title: Documenting RAM and Timeout Requirements for 1-Minute Clips in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update solidifies the prerequisites for running one-minute digital human clips on a 3090 box, specifically requiring at least 24GB of system RAM and adjustments to the timeout ceiling. Key changes include modifications to the README to clarify these requirements, ensuring smoother operations and preventing out-of-memory errors during rendering. The successful validation of these settings has been documented, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: Streamline Mobile Controls for Coding Bridge in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update collapses secondary composer controls into a single toggle on mobile devices, keeping only the backend picker visible. The desktop layout remains unchanged, ensuring a consistent user experience across platforms. Additionally, a bug related to the visibility of the 'devices' button has been fixed, enhancing overall functionality.

items.title: Refine working directory placement for better UX in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: The working directory entry has been moved below the input box to enhance visual coherence with the disclaimer. The style has been updated to a subtle text link, ensuring it does not distract from the main content. Additionally, tooltips now display the full path for improved clarity, while the functionality remains unchanged.

items.title: Streamline Authorization Popup Behavior in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the authorization popup for DCR connectors, ensuring it closes automatically upon completion, including for custom MCP servers. Key changes include removing unnecessary postMessage listeners and simplifying the return type to indicate completion. The new implementation enhances user experience by preventing the need for manual window closure and maintaining the state of the main application.

items.title: Streamline Popup Closure for Connections in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the popup handling for connection flows, ensuring that all terminal states now automatically close the popup window. Key changes include the removal of unnecessary token parsing and the introduction of a dedicated exit function, enhancing user experience by preventing the popup from hanging. The modifications also ensure that SSO logins remain unaffected while improving overall flow consistency.

items.title: Streamline Popup Handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the popup handling mechanism for DCR connections, eliminating unnecessary complexity by removing the postMessage signature checks. The new approach ensures that the main window can automatically close the popup based on its state without relying on cross-origin messaging. Key changes include the introduction of a new return URL recovery method and the deletion of outdated signature-related code.

items.title: Enhance Agent Health Check with Deep Endpoint in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new `GET /api/health/deep` endpoint that forwards requests to the agent's health check, addressing a critical issue where the agent could be unreachable while the platform reported a healthy status. The change ensures that if the agent is down, a 503 error will be returned, allowing for better monitoring and response. Additionally, the existing shallow health check remains unchanged to prevent unnecessary disruptions.

items.title: Optimize MCP Tool Schema Handling in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a significant optimization by deferring local MCP tool schemas instead of sending them with every turn. The change reduces the data size dramatically, saving up to 96% in token usage during conversations. Additionally, it ensures backward compatibility with older workers while enhancing the overall efficiency of the desktop application.

items.title: Enhance Suno Clip State Derivation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the way the Suno clip state is derived, shifting from a job-wide progress to a per-clip basis. The changes ensure that each clip reflects its actual state based on its audio URL, improving data accuracy for clients. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate these changes and ensure alignment with expected behaviors.

items.title: Enhance Debug Exec Safety in Wisdom 🔒
items.summary: This update introduces critical limits on the `/api/debug/exec` endpoint to prevent excessive resource usage that can crash devices. New constraints cap the submitted code at 64 KB and output at 256 KB, ensuring that no single diagnostic session can overwhelm the system. Additionally, stderr is now captured alongside stdout to mitigate risks of bypassing safeguards.

items.title: Boosted Data Directory Discovery Speed in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update significantly reduces the time taken to locate the data directory during the initial login process. By prioritizing the use of glob for single account scenarios and implementing a time budget for handle scans, the preparation time has been cut down from several minutes to just milliseconds. The changes have been validated with comprehensive tests, ensuring reliability and performance improvements.

items.title: Enhance Observability for Agent Status in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the observability of agent status by distinguishing between a dead agent and a slow one. Key changes include enhanced logging in the gateway and health check scripts, allowing for clearer diagnostics during outages. The modifications ensure that future issues can be quickly identified and addressed, improving overall system reliability.

items.title: Fix logging issue causing missing API logs in Wisdom 🛠️
items.summary: This update addresses a critical logging issue where the API logs were not being recorded for an entire day due to the use of `Tee-Object`, which buffers output until the pipeline ends. The script has been modified to use direct redirection, ensuring logs are captured in real-time. Additionally, a new logging setup has been implemented for the supervisor, gateway, and agent processes, allowing each to maintain its own log file.

items.title: Fix email layout issues and outdated messaging in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a layout overlap in the email recipient area, ensuring proper visibility across various screen sizes. Additionally, outdated messaging related to wave delivery processes has been removed, aligning the interface with the current workflow. The changes enhance user experience and clarity in email marketing functionalities.

items.title: Optimize Local MCP Tool Loading in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces deferred loading for desktop local MCP tools, significantly reducing the data sent with each request. By only sending a summary of the tools instead of full schemas, we achieve a 96% reduction in token usage, enhancing performance and user experience. Key changes include modifications to the health endpoint and the introduction of new local MCP handling logic.

items.title: Enhance Clickable Containers in Snapshots in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where clickable containers were not appearing in truncated snapshots, causing the upload functionality to fail. By filtering out `InlineTextBox` nodes before reaching the node limit, we ensure that the clickable elements remain accessible. The changes have been thoroughly tested, passing all tests and ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Unify Sidebar and Page Layout for a Smoother Experience in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update addresses multiple layout issues in the Studio console, including sidebar overflow and inconsistent panel borders. Key changes include establishing a single source of truth for sidebar width, implementing structural adjustments to prevent overflow, and utilizing global tokens for consistent styling. These improvements enhance the overall user experience and maintain visual integrity across various pages.

items.title: Fix tray icon visibility issue in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves critical issues with the tray icon not being included in the macOS app bundle, which previously resulted in an invisible menu bar icon. A new script generates the necessary tray images and ensures they are copied to the correct directory during the build process. This change enhances user experience by making the app's running status visible and accessible.

items.title: Exciting Updates: New Commands and Fixes in Clis 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces the new `inspo` command for the `suno` CLI, allowing users to generate music from audio seeds. Additionally, the `hailuo` model has been fixed to include `minimax-t2v` in its options. A brand new Maestro CLI has been added, providing a comprehensive tool for video generation and management. These enhancements improve functionality and user experience across the board.

items.title: Sync models and types with latest OpenAPI specs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes four MCP servers with the latest AceDataCloud/Docs OpenAPI specifications. Key changes include the addition of new model variants in `flux`, `grok`, `maestro`, and `nanobanana`, along with updates to type definitions in `core/types.py`. These enhancements improve the functionality and consistency of the services, ensuring they align with the latest API standards.

items.title: Enable Global Sending Switch in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a global sending switch directly in the email configuration interface, addressing user concerns about its previous inaccessibility. Key changes include the addition of a switch card that requires a reason for toggling and backend confirmation for enabling sending. The readiness checklist now accurately reflects the global switch status, ensuring users are informed of the current sending capabilities.

items.title: Enhance Overview to Include Sending Pause Reason in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the `GET /admin/overview/` endpoint to return the reason for a paused sending state, allowing the console to provide clearer explanations. A new test has been added to ensure that the overview correctly reflects the reason when the sending is paused. This change improves transparency for users managing email marketing settings.

items.title: Enhance error logging for invalid requests in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the error handling in the browser relay by specifying which field caused a request to be invalid. Now, when a request fails validation, the logs and response will include the field name and the type of constraint violated, making it easier to diagnose issues. This change aims to reduce the time spent troubleshooting by providing clearer feedback on validation errors.

items.title: Require Working Directory Selection Before Sending Messages on Desktop in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces that users must select a working directory before sending messages on the desktop version. The chat interface now disables the send button and shows a prompt for directory selection if none is chosen. Additionally, a new settings section allows users to change their working directory at any time, with immediate saving to ensure the chat page reflects the latest changes.

items.title: Fix counting of newly created rows in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where duplicate reports of skipped ticks incorrectly counted as new entries. By introducing a new function, `upsertRunReportingInsert`, the system now accurately distinguishes between newly created and existing rows. This change ensures that the reported counts reflect true data, preventing inflated metrics in logs and UI displays.

items.title: Enhance Project Directory Awareness in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new optional field, `working_directory`, to the request body, allowing the model to recognize the user's current project directory. The change ensures that relative paths are resolved based on this directory, enhancing user experience by eliminating guesswork. Additionally, security measures have been implemented to sanitize inputs and prevent potential injection attacks.

items.title: Persist Working Directory in Nexior 🌟
items.summary: This update introduces a persistent working directory feature for local tools in Nexior, allowing the main process to retain the user's current project directory. Key changes include the addition of a `workingDir` field in `LocalConfig`, which streamlines interactions with shell and project tools without requiring repeated parameters. Additionally, security improvements ensure that the working directory is validated, preventing unauthorized access to user directories.

items.title: Fix zIndex Handling for Preview Drawer in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the preview drawer was not visible due to incorrect zIndex handling. The `useZIndex()` function is now correctly called within the setup function, ensuring that the drawer appears above other components. Additionally, the same fix has been applied to the resend confirmation dialog in the CampaignDetail component to prevent similar issues.

items.title: Fix email selection count and drawer visibility issues in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update addresses two critical bugs: the incorrect display of selected user counts due to a race condition and the visibility issue of the preview drawer being obscured by the dialog. The solution involves updating the segment handling to ensure accurate counts and adjusting z-index values to ensure the drawer is properly displayed. Both issues were identified through backend verification, enhancing the reliability of the UI.

items.title: Fix local tool authorization matching in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical bug where local tool authorization failed due to mismatched naming conventions. The fix ensures that the authorization checks now correctly match the `displayName` instead of the sanitized `name`, preventing silent failures and improving user experience. Comprehensive regression tests have been added to validate the changes.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Tasks with Cloud and Local Execution Options in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability to choose whether scheduled tasks run in the cloud or locally on the device. It includes a new form field for execution location, device identification for local tasks, and improved authorization for local tools. Additionally, it addresses existing type mismatches and enhances internationalization support with new keys for multiple languages.

items.title: Fix(aichat2): 流式对话中途落库，滚动部署不再丢整轮会话 in Platform Service 🐛
Enhance Console UI with Responsive Dialogs and Search Inputs in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the console's user interface by standardizing dialog widths to prevent overflow on tablet screens and aligning breakpoints to 767px. Additionally, the search inputs across various components have been replaced with `el-input` for a consistent look and feel, enhancing usability. The changes ensure a more cohesive experience across the application.

items.title: Enhance Task Management with New Tool in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `manage_todos` tool, allowing users to view a complete list of tasks during multi-step processes. By returning the full task list with each call, it ensures consistency and visibility, preventing issues with context loss. The implementation includes robust testing to validate functionality and handle various edge cases.

items.title: Enhance Local Tools with Directory-Level Authorization in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new directory-level authorization tier, allowing users to grant permissions for specific tools within designated folders without repeated prompts. The implementation includes a new button in the authorization dialog and ensures strict boundary checks to prevent unintended access. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the functionality across different operating systems.

items.title: Enhance Persistent Shell and Project Context in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a persistent shell for session management, allowing commands to retain their working directory, environment variables, and background processes across calls. Additionally, it implements a project context loading mechanism that ensures the correct project conventions are applied based on the working directory, enhancing overall usability and reliability. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate these features.

items.title: Local Scheduled Tasks Daemon for Desktop in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a local daemon for executing scheduled tasks directly from the main process, enhancing the desktop experience. Key features include a system tray for task management, automatic startup on login, and improved handling of credentials securely stored on disk. The implementation ensures that tasks run reliably even when the application window is closed, maintaining user convenience and system performance.

items.title: Enable local execution mode for scheduled tasks in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new execution mode for scheduled tasks, allowing them to run locally on the user's desktop instead of exclusively in the cloud. The architecture remains unchanged, but the task initiator shifts from user-triggered to a local daemon timer. Key features include a three-step device protocol for task retrieval, claiming, and finalization, improved client tool authorization, and enhanced handling of offline devices with skipped run records. Compatibility is maintained with zero migration impact on existing cloud tasks.

items.title: Center Brand Logo and Enhance Dark Mode in Nexior 🌟
items.summary: This update addresses three key issues on the share page header: the logo is now centered, the duplicate site title has been removed, and the logo is adapted for dark mode. The layout has been modified to ensure the logo remains visually appealing across different languages, while the logo's appearance in dark mode has been improved for better visibility.

items.title: Update TypeScript ESLint Parser to Latest Version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the @typescript-eslint/parser from version 8.63.0 to 8.65.0. Key improvements include added warnings for TypeScript 7 detection and enhanced error handling for unsupported TypeScript versions. These changes aim to improve code quality and maintainability in the project.
